[[Mahk]] lives in Kamadan with his [[Mahk's Wife|wife]] and [[Mahk's Son|son]]. He makes toys.

==Dialogue==
If The Toy's Story has not not been completed:
:''"Not everything in life needs to be serious! I see heroes running around trying to save the world, but they never take the time to enjoy the world or have some fun in it! That's where I come in. I make toys."''
If The Toy's Story has been completed:
:''"That contract was signed, twice! In gold ink. The gems encrusted on the scroll will put my son through the best schools. I can finally do what I love! Thank you, thank you, thank you!"''
